correctness.rationale: For n at least 10, a five-vertex window contains seven host edges. Four or more deletions have union-bound probability at most 35nq^4. A singleton run in any component coloring forces four deleted edges locally, so on the complementary event all component-label runs have length at least two, all boundaries are three-deletion walls, and K=max(1,W). Adjacent walls share one edge and occur with probability q^5, while nonadjacent walls are independent with probability q^6. Counting adjacency clusters gives the point-process factorial moments, and the conditional uniform Poisson spacings give Dirichlet component lengths. Exact finite verification passed 8,935 checks; it does not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The source 2026 manuscript explicitly requests small-bandwidth critical-window component laws, and its Theorem 4 assumes m/log n tends to infinity. Federico (2024) studies the identical fixed-range lattice family and proves a 0/1 threshold away from criticality, but not the critical Poisson component distribution, conditional Dirichlet spacings, or the explicit all-component rigidity bound. The 2020 random-position soft graph is a different model. Main residual risk is an older equivalent special-case network-reliability theorem.
residual_risks: An older same-model network-reliability paper or theorem could already give the fixed-width Poisson connectivity-window probability or Dirichlet component spacings.
The known fixed-range threshold and existence of cut walls are not original and are intentionally excluded from the novelty claim.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary manuscript explicitly asks for the critical distribution of nontrivial interval components in the small-band regime. This result resolves the simplest nontrivial fixed band completely: all component count probabilities, exact e^-lambda(1+lambda) connectivity, spatial Poisson walls, conditional macroscopic Dirichlet spacings, and a quantitative finite-volume geometric reduction. These are scientifically more informative than the previously established threshold and arise from a natural network-reliability invariant.
